title: Unit faces, localized sharpening and induced group map of a tensor chart
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $R,Q$ commutative monoids, $\alpha:R\to(A,\cdot)$ and $h:R\to Q$ monoid homomorphisms. Write $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ for the chart tensor ring with its canonical monomial map, and, for a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset C$, write $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$ and $\beta:Q\to B$ for the localized tensor monomial map [def-per-formal-monoid-extension-data]. Define $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)\subset R$ and $F=\beta^{-1}(B^\times)\subset Q$. Define the localized sharp target $T=(Q_F)^\sharp=Q_F/(Q_F)^\times$, where $Q_F$ is the monoid localization of $Q$ inverting $F$; in multiplicative notation this is the monoid of associates of $Q_F$. For any submonoid $H\subset Q$, define $Q\to(Q_H)^\sharp$ to be localization followed by passage to associates. The group completions and the induced map $h^{\rm gp}:R^{\rm gp}\to Q^{\rm gp}$ are those of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]: the latter sends the class of $r$ to the class of $h(r)$. No group-isomorphism, integrality, finiteness or face-contraction assertion is part of this definition.
